findings.title: Missing Defensive HTTP Security Headers (4 missing)
findings.observation: The web server response does not include standard defensive headers: Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS), Content-Security-Policy (CSP), X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options.
findings.evidence: Response headers from https://example.com/ were inspected. Found: {"hsts":null,"csp":null,"xFrameOptions":null,"xContentTypeOptions":null,"referrerPolicy":null,"permissionsPolicy":null}
findings.impact: Leaves the website vulnerable to clickjacking (missing X-Frame-Options), MIME-type sniffing, and cross-site scripting risks.
findings.recommendation: Configure your web server (Nginx/Apache/Cloudflare) to send HSTS, X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff headers.

findings.title: Missing Meta Descriptions (1/1 pages)
findings.impact: Search engines will automatically generate snippets from random body text, resulting in lower click-through rates (CTR) from search results.
findings.recommendation: Add unique, compelling meta descriptions (130-160 characters) containing primary keywords and a clear call to action for every page.

findings.title: Missing Canonical URL Tags (1/1 pages)
findings.observation: 1 pages do not declare a self-referencing canonical URL.
findings.evidence: Canonical tags are missing from <head> on 1 crawled pages.
findings.impact: Risk of duplicate content penalties when pages are accessed via different URL variations (HTTP vs HTTPS, trailing slash, query parameters).
findings.recommendation: Add self-referencing <link rel="canonical" href="https://..." /> tags in the <head> of every published page.

findings.title: Limited Direct Lead Capture & Contact Channels
findings.observation: No clickable phone links (tel:), direct WhatsApp buttons, or interactive enquiry forms were detected across crawled pages.
findings.evidence: Inspected contact signals across 1 pages. Found: 0 phone numbers, 0 forms.
findings.impact: Creates significant friction for prospective clients attempting to reach out, resulting in lost conversions and enquiries.
findings.recommendation: Add prominent "Call Now" (tel:), "Chat on WhatsApp", and quick quote enquiry forms in the header, hero, and sticky footer.

findings.title: Visual Hierarchy & Focal Point Modernization
findings.observation: Above-the-fold layout could benefit from stronger headline typography contrast, clear primary call-to-action prominence, and elevated modern spacing tokens.
findings.evidence: Evaluated 1 crawled templates. Visual inspection of hero and body sections indicates opportunity for enhanced visual contrast and modern design tokens.
findings.impact: Modern, high-contrast visual design builds instant visitor trust and dramatically improves engagement time on landing.
findings.recommendation: Implement a refined typographic hierarchy (48px+ H1 hero, 20px lead paragraph), distinct high-contrast CTA button styling, and consistent 64px+ section spacing.

findings.title: Lead Capture & Instant Engagement Opportunity
findings.observation: The website lacks instant real-time conversion channels such as floating WhatsApp buttons or frictionless 2-field lead capture forms.
findings.evidence: Inspected conversion triggers across 1 pages. Direct WhatsApp messaging links or streamlined quote forms were not detected in the primary navigation or sticky footer.
findings.impact: Up to 60% of modern mobile visitors prefer instant chat or 1-click quote requests over navigating to a separate contact page.
findings.recommendation: Add a persistent floating WhatsApp contact widget and an above-the-fold "Get Instant Quote" trigger.
